title: 23-BCV-006 — Occupancy classification of natural gas regulating and metering buildings

facts.text: The variance applies to Group F, Division 1 high-hazard industrial occupancies housing natural-gas regulating and metering equipment.

It permits Group F, Division 2 classification if the building is low-human-occupancy, does not exceed 55 m² in area or one storey in height, and has sufficient ventilation to prevent small leaks accumulating.
The source references Sentence 6.3.1.5.(1) on indoor air contaminants.
